title: Preservation Under Agreement on the Interval
statement: Let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, $a,N,\mathrm{top}\in\mathbb{N}$, $l$ be a list of integers, and $U\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose $l$ has length $N$, its $j$th entry is $\mu(a+j)$ for each $j<N$, every entry has absolute value at most $U$, and $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$. Suppose also that $\mu'(b)=\mu(b)$ whenever $a\le b<a+N$ and $b<\mathrm{top}$. Then the same list satisfies these array conditions for $\mu'$ with the same $a,N,U,\mathrm{top}$.
hypotheses_covered: The original array conditions for μ: length N, segment values, absolute bound U, and a+N≤top
μ' agrees with μ at every b with a≤b<a+N and b<top
